subject: literature
passage: Pavel had come to help his grandmother with her shopping, but Olga Petrovna would not hear of it. When he reached for the heaviest bag, she pulled it away, tucked it under her arm, and marched up the four flights of stairs ahead of him. At the top, she did not even stop to rest. Pavel only sighed. At eighty-one, his grandmother was as fiercely ______ as ever.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: Olga "would not hear of" being helped: she pulls the bag away from Pavel and carries it up four flights herself. Someone who insists on doing things without help is independent, so "independent" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Nothing in the text shows Olga being forgetful or distracted; the scene is about her refusing help.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Olga is not giving anything to anyone. She refuses Pavel's help, which shows self-reliance, not generosity.
explanation.C: Correct. Olga refuses help and carries the heaviest bag herself, so she is fiercely independent, meaning she insists on doing things on her own.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Grabbing the bag and marching up the stairs ahead of Pavel is bold behavior, the opposite of timid.
